name: metis-mcp
description: Registers the Métis MCP server. Twelve read-only tools over the behaviour graph and the knowledge in it: list_workflows, route_request, get_model, validate_model, coverage, run_status, why_read_only, search_knowledge, list_entities, get_entity, get_requirement and get_spec. Read-only by construction (§9.5, N-8) — no decision may be taken through this surface, so landing, approval and publication go through the CLI, where the gates are. Requires a running Métis server and a Neo4j graph.
